data.title: Volga Tower
data.about:
Welcome to Volga Tower  at Jumeirah Village Triangle, where elevated living meets modern luxury. Discover fully furnished apartments ranging from 1 to 4 bedrooms, each featuring a private pool. Experience a lifestyle of opulence and ease in the heart of this exquisite residence. Relish the tranquility of your personal pool while enjoying the comfort of your thoughtfully designed home. Volga Tower JVT by Tiger Properties brings your dream of lavish living with unmatched convenience to life.

Among its remarkable attributes are a wealth of amenities and water features, meticulously crafted to provide residents with a vibrant and sustainable urban lifestyle. Enjoy access to a striking swimming pool, a well-appointed gymnasium, dedicated cycling and fitness tracks, nearby supermarkets for hassle-free shopping, and a variety of dining options. The community even boasts an on-site school, ensuring educational facilities are within reach. With sports courts available, it's the perfect place for families to flourish.

This residential development presents a promising investment opportunity in Dubai's thriving real estate landscape. As the demand for premium living spaces continues to rise, Volga Tower JVT stands as a compelling choice for investors seeking both capital growth and a lavish lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Feel Luxury Living at Volga Tower
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diverse Apartments: Offers 1 to 4-bedroom furnished apartments with private pools.
  • Thriving Community: 40 residential floors create a vibrant community atmosphere.
  • Architectural Masterpiece: Features a stunning, innovative architectural design.
  • Prime Location: Conveniently situated in the heart of JVT with access to urban amenities.
  • Great Connectivity: Well-connected to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.
  • Dining Convenience: Surrounded by diverse dining options within walking distance.
  • Swimming Pool: Enjoy a refreshing pool for relaxation and staying active.

location_tile.title: Prime Living in Jumeirah Village Triangle
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Jumeirah Village Triangle prioritizes community living and family-friendly amenities. With numerous retail stores, supermarkets, and dining establishments, residents enjoy easy access to daily essentials. Moreover, Volga Tower in JVT features international schools, making it an ideal choice for families with school-age children.

Strategically situated, JVT provides seamless access to major highways, facilitating quick reach to key Dubai areas, including vibrant business districts, entertainment centers, and pristine beaches. Its central location makes JVT a sought-after destination for professionals and families alike.

  • 10 Minutes - JBR
  • 15 Minutes - The Palm Jumeirah
  • 15 Minutes - The Mall of the Emirates
  • 17 Minutes - The Global Village
  • 20 Minutes - The Dubai Mall
